title: Better Than Copper
description: A Datapack To Make Minecraft A Little-Bit Harder And Grindier,Inspired From Better Than Wolves.
body:
**INSPIRED FROM BETTER THAN WOLVES**
# Info-
Made Because Of the long waiting time for copper age update.
Makes the grind longer, and harder, made for the orginal modpack.

Have Fun :D

**Raw Iron Now Gives Nuggets, Instead Of Iron Ingots**
Silk Touch Has Not Been Changed, Giving 1 Ingot For 1 Ore,
Blast Furnaces Will Give Ingots For Raw Iron, for Late Game Efficiency.

**You Can Cook Iron In Campfires Now.**

**PLEASE CHECK GALLERY FOR RECIPES**

### Changes-
### 
1. Changes For Recipes-
- Arrow
- Barrel
- Blast Furnace
- Furnace
- Campfire
- Chest
- Diamond Chesplate
- Iron Chestplate
- Enchanting Table

### Short Note-
You All Were Lucky There Wasn't A Netherite Chesplate Recipe >:D
